quote: We recruit annotators through Prolific, ensuring the following: (1) they are native speakers of the target language; (2) have spent most of their lives in the target country; (3) their nationality aligns with the target country; (4) they identify as monocultural in relation to the target country and (5) they currently reside in the target country.
guideline: Each annotator is provided with a definition of hate speech along with examples in their native language... and is asked to label each meme (combination of image and embed caption) as hate speech, non-hate speech, or I don't know.
